purpose: Bind every T10-T70 forward execution gate to one reusable execution contract so task workflows do not improvise duplicate or contradictory harnesses.

scope_dependency.rule: Fail before checkout/build fan-out when dependencies are not APPROVED or the task plan does not resolve.

ownership.rule: Foreign/protected/integration-only edits fail closed; use ChangeRequests instead.

reference_lock.runner: task packet reference manifest + exact source hashes
reference_lock.rule: Freeze authoritative reference inputs before visual implementation; C1 tasks require both reference lock and final source-bound visual evidence.

source_contract.rule: Validate frozen task semantics and required registries before expensive testing.

focused_unit.rule: Run the smallest deterministic tests that can reject the candidate before integrated fan-out.

task_sentinel.rule: Implement the profile's named high-information sentinel before broad production implementation; a task may not enter full fan-out without it.

motion_preflight.rule: Validate full-cycle/transition/contact initialization before long visual fan-out; preserve final-skeleton evidence rather than using screenshot identity as motion identity.

progression_sim.rule: Task simulation produces the source-bound record; the shared gate enforces Level-100/F2P/difficulty invariants.

economy_sim.rule: Task simulation produces the source-bound record; the shared gate enforces F2P/store/VIP/paywall invariants.

device_matrix.rule: Exercise phone/tablet/foldable functional states before physical release certification.

security_attack.rule: Use adversarial attack cases; never replace C9 with prose review.

liveops_sim.rule: Task rehearsal produces the source-bound record; the shared gate enforces scheduling/collision/reward/kill-switch/F2P invariants.

impacted_regression.rule: Run universal plus impacted suites; unknown production changes fall back to full mandatory coverage; V3.1 learned runtime dependencies may add but never subtract suites.

performance.rule: Measure after cheaper functional/specialist preflights pass; do not use this as T68/T69 physical certification.

visual_evidence.rule: Produce one hash-bound evidence bundle per SHA and reuse it across critics only when fingerprint and environment/provenance rules permit.

physical_device.rule: No emulator, desktop render, engine counter or screenshot substitution for sustained physical 4K/60 and thermal evidence.

critic_review.rule: C1-C11 applicability comes from CRITIC_MATRIX; C0 is non-voting.

integration.rule: Build-mode tasks only; candidate builders cannot self-integrate or self-approve.

post_integration_regression.rule: Fresh integration evidence is required; isolated evidence cannot substitute after integration changes the source SHA.

closeout.rule: Before closeout, preserve factory-observation.json from the terminal source-bound run. No closeout with missing critic records, unresolved mandatory defects, stale hashes, incomplete forward contracts, missing durable approval provenance, missing factory observation, or missing final derived task-state snapshot.

release_manifest.runner: T70 release manifest/provenance closure + V3.1 factory observation + evidence retention + proof-invalidation check
release_manifest.rule: Bind accepted sources, artifact hashes, physical certifications, rollback/recovery, durable provenance, terminal factory observation and zero open mandatory defects.
